verdict.rationale: Token2's evidence covers hardware-key management tools: desktop and mobile apps, the fido2-manage CLI/GUI and a bulk-enrollment script built on Microsoft's Graph API. No first-party machine-readable API spec is documented, and the OpenAPI/Swagger probes at standard paths all returned 404. JSON/CSV device exports and use of a third-party Graph API are different features and do not count as a downloadable API spec.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)
